trials.name: help
trials.stdout:
Liquid Glass read-only CSS checks

liquid-glass lint <paths...> [--root project] [--format text|json]
liquid-glass lint --stdin [--name relative.css] [--format text|json]
liquid-glass hook claude-post-tool-use --root project

Use literal CSS file paths; no scanning, glob expansion, fixes or commands.
Configured rules: parser syntax, border-raduis typo, transition:all warning.
Limits: 32 files, 256000 bytes/64000 UTF-16 code units per file, 2048000 aggregate bytes, 1024000 aggregate code units, 30 diagnostics/file, 120 displayed total.
Interior symlinks and non-regular files are rejected; UTF-8 decoding is strict.
Lint exits:0 clean configured checks or reported skips;1 findings;2 invalid invocation/read/limit errors. Skipped does not mean checked.
Hook output is advisory context, never a permission or approval decision.
